Title: TFGTRS-4447 - No Constructor 400 "item_id: Field required" in SFCC logs after browsing - Phase Eight UK
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Access to the SFCC Business Manager log files (or Log Center) for Sites-P8-UK-Site.
Steps:
1. Note the current time.
2. On dev.phase-eight.com browse the flows that use Constructor: search with suggestions, a PLP, a PDP with recommendations, add to bag.
3. In Business Manager open the log files and look for entries after the noted time with service constructor.http.api.
4. Search the entries for "item_id".
Expected: No error or fatal entry with status 400 and message {"message":"item_id: Field required"} appears for constructor.http.api.

Title: TFGTRS-4447 - No SFCC Critical Alert (Fatal Log) for constructor.http.api after deploy
Pre-Condition: The fix is deployed to the environment being checked (staging, then production). Access to the Grafana dashboard sfcc-overview-tfg.
Steps:
1. After the deploy, monitor the Grafana dashboard for 24 hours.
2. Check whether the "SFCC Critical Alert - Fatal Log - TFG" alert fires for Sites-P8-UK-Site.
Expected: The alert does not fire for the Constructor integration and there are no new fatal logs from constructor.http.api.

Title: TFGTRS-4447 - The same error does not appear on other brands

Steps:
